class.name: GoetheDialogueRunner
class.description: [GoetheDialogueRunner] drives a [GoetheDialogue] through its branching state machine, evaluating conditions and applying effects via optional duck-typed hooks on [member context] while emitting presentation signals.

method.name: abort
method.description: Aborts the active dialogue run immediately and emits [signal dialogue_aborted].

method.name: advance
method.description: Advances past the current linear beat when not waiting on player choices.

method.name: get_choices
method.description: Returns the resolved choices currently offered at the active node.

method.name: get_context
method.description: Returns the game-state context object assigned via [method set_context], or [code]null[/code].

method.name: get_current_node
method.description: Returns a copy of the most recently presented node payload dictionary.

method.name: get_current_node_id
method.description: Returns the ID of the currently presented node.

method.name: get_dialogue
method.description: Returns the [GoetheDialogue] currently bound to this runner.

method.name: get_dialogue_id
method.description: Returns the ID of the active dialogue.

method.name: get_state
method.description: Returns the current state machine state.

method.name: is_active
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] while a dialogue is actively running, waiting for a choice, or suspended.

method.name: is_waiting_choice
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] when the runner is waiting for [method select_choice].

method.name: select_choice
method.description: Selects the choice identified by [param choice_id]. Returns [code]false[/code] if the choice is unavailable or disabled.

method.name: set_context
method.description: Sets the optional game-state context object queried for condition and effect hooks.

method.name: start
method.description: Starts running [param dialogue] from its start node.

members.member: When [code]true[/code], skips [GoetheLocaleManager] translation and emits raw localization keys.

signal.name: choice_selected
signal.description: Emitted after a player choice has been accepted.

signal.name: choices_offered
signal.description: Emitted when choices become available on [param node_id].

signal.name: dialogue_aborted
signal.description: Emitted when the dialogue aborts early.

signal.name: dialogue_completed
signal.description: Emitted when the dialogue reaches completion.

signal.name: dialogue_resumed
signal.description: Emitted when a suspended dialogue resumes.

signal.name: dialogue_started
signal.description: Emitted when a dialogue begins executing.

signal.name: dialogue_suspended
signal.description: Emitted when the dialogue is suspended.

signal.name: effect_triggered
signal.description: Emitted whenever a node or choice effect fires.

signal.name: node_presented
signal.description: Emitted when a dialogue beat is presented to the UI.

constants.constant: No dialogue has been started yet.
Runner is initializing a dialogue run.
A linear dialogue beat is active and awaiting [method advance].
Choices have been presented and the runner is awaiting [method select_choice].
The dialogue run is paused via [method suspend].
The dialogue reached its end cleanly.
The dialogue was aborted via [method abort] or an error.
